title: Create /dashboard/chat Page and Integrate Chat Interface
description: Add a new page at app/dashboard/chat/page.tsx that renders the ChatInterface component, ensuring it is protected by authentication and fits within the dashboard layout.
details:
- Create app/dashboard/chat/page.tsx as a Next.js page.
- Import and render the ChatInterface component.
- Ensure the page is wrapped in the dashboard layout and inherits authentication protection.
- Test on both mobile and desktop for responsive design and dark mode compatibility.
test_strategy:
- Write page-level tests to verify authentication protection, layout integration, and correct rendering of the chat interface.
- Perform manual UI/UX testing on different devices and themes.

title: Update Dashboard Sidebar Navigation
description: Add a navigation link to the new /dashboard/chat page in the dashboard sidebar for easy user access.
details:
- Modify components/ui/sidebar.tsx (or equivalent) to include a link labeled 'Chat' pointing to /dashboard/chat.
- Ensure the new link matches the style and active state behavior of existing sidebar items.
- Optionally, add an icon consistent with shadcn/ui iconography.
test_strategy:
- Write unit tests for the sidebar to verify the presence and correct behavior of the new link.
- Perform manual navigation tests to ensure the link routes correctly and highlights when active.

title: End-to-End Testing of Chat Flow
description: Implement E2E tests to validate the full chat experience: login, navigation, sending a message, and receiving a streamed AI response.
details:
- Use Playwright or Cypress to automate the following flow: user logs in, navigates to /dashboard/chat, sends a message, and observes the streamed AI reply.
- Test for error handling, streaming interruptions, and UI responsiveness.
- Validate that only authenticated users can access the chat page and API route.
test_strategy:
- Write E2E test scripts covering the main chat flow, error scenarios, and access control.
- Run tests on both desktop and mobile viewports to ensure responsiveness and accessibility.

title: Implement /api/chat API Route with Vercel AI SDK
description: Create a new API route at app/api/chat/route.ts that receives chat prompts, calls the AI model via the Vercel AI SDK, streams responses, and handles errors securely.
details:
- Create app/api/chat/route.ts as a Next.js API route.
- Implement a POST handler that authenticates the user using Better Auth session cookies.
- Use the Vercel @ai-sdk (e.g., @ai-sdk/openai) to send user prompts to the AI model and stream back responses.
- Ensure the OPENAI_API_KEY is securely accessed from environment variables and never exposed to the client.
- Handle streaming, error states, and rate limiting gracefully.
- Return streamed responses in a format compatible with @assistant-ui/react-ui on the frontend.
test_strategy:
- Write unit tests for the API route to verify authentication, error handling, and correct streaming of responses.
- Use integration tests to simulate POST requests with valid/invalid payloads and check for proper AI responses and error messages.

title: Develop Chat Interface Component with assistant-ui
description: Build a new client-side React component using @assistant-ui/react and @assistant-ui/react-ui to provide a full-featured chat interface.
details:
- Create components/ui/chat-interface.tsx as a client component ('use client').
- Use the useAssistant hook from @ai-sdk/react to connect to /api/chat and manage chat state.
- Integrate @assistant-ui/react-ui components for the chat UI (message list, input, streaming display, error/loading states).
- Ensure the component inherits styles from Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui for visual consistency.
- Implement optimistic UI updates for user messages and robust error handling for streaming failures.
test_strategy:
- Write component tests to verify rendering, user input, message display, and streaming updates.
- Use mocking to simulate API responses and error conditions.
- Test accessibility (keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes).
